text: Real-size calibration: measure first painting, reuse across sessions
description: On the first digitalization of a session, after selecting the 4 corners, prompt for the actual measured width/height (cm) → store px/cm calibration. At the start of later sessions ask "Same distance from camera to painting as before? (reuse calibration)" — yes reuses it, no triggers a fresh measurement. Warn that the camera must not move within a session. Real size of every painting is then derived, making captures from different sessions comparable.

status.comment: Now true 3D: focal length from EXIF (a6400: focal mm × width / 23.5 mm; else 35 mm equivalent), rectangle reconstructed via P0+P2=P1+P3, scale so the painting center sits at the calibrated depth. Synthetic tests: exact for tilts up to 25°; with ±3 px click noise 0.1–0.7 % median error vs 0.3–2.8 % before. Capture UI shows tilt and corner-angle error.
